main.remarks: Denies policy evaluation when the access-key manifest identity does not match the current tool state.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether the supplied policy context matches the current manifest identity.
method.returns: Deny when the manifest identity does not match; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether the supplied policy context matches the current manifest identity.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when the manifest identity does not match; otherwise allow.
